name: AMD Radeon RX Vega 64 product page (Wayback capture 2020-11-18, spec table)
notes: Live amd.com URL no longer serves this product. Transcribed from the Wayback capture of the AMD product-page spec table: Compute Units 64, Base Frequency 1247 MHz, Boost Frequency 1546 MHz, Peak Pixel Fill-Rate 98.94 GP/s, Peak Texture Fill-Rate 395.8 GT/s, Peak Half Precision Compute Performance 25.3 TFLOPs, Peak Single Precision Compute Performance 12.66 TFLOPs, Peak Double Precision Compute Performance 0.79 TFLOPs, Stream Processors 4096, Texture Units 256, Transistor Count 12.5 B, Typical Board Power (Desktop) 295 W, Memory Speed (Effective) 1.89 Gbps, Max Memory Size 8 GB, Memory Type (GPU) HBM2, Memory Interface 2048-bit, Max. Memory Bandwidth 484 GB/s, Launch Date Q3/2017. 1.89 Gbps times 2048-bit divided by 8 equals 483.8 GB/s, consistent with the printed 484 GB/s. No sparsity footnote is printed.
